77ff4de3.text:
A note is attached to the crate.  It reads:

"Verner - sorry to hear Redridge is having such trouble.  Here are the shoes you need.  Please pay me 100 silver at your earliest convenience."

"Or if you like, you can pay me in underbelly scales from black dragon whelps (I hear Dragon Whelps are common in the Redridge Mountains).  Because we're friends... 4 scales will be enough.  Thanks --Argus"
77ff4de3.title: Crate of Horseshoes

e6b3aeb4.text:
That beast that reigns over this island is terribly powerful indeed. The other creatures here cower before him: Skyman and Jaguero alike. Even now I can hear his roars and they cause me to flinch.

These creatures will surely stop any who come to the island. I must have faith in my ancestors.
e6b3aeb4.title: Ripped Note

1070|bd6c9aff.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|bd6c9aff.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lad, then mark me--you've found it!

1103|4ac3ad23.name: Eldrin
1103|4ac3ad23.text: I'm a simple man who knows a few things about tailoring, but you need more assistance than I can provide. I have heard of a Night Elf who is quite an accomplished tailor. He resides in Stormwind, in the Magic District.

11041|711bbaa2.name: Milla Fairancora
11041|711bbaa2.text: You are kind to seek me out, but your skills are beyond my own. Have a word with Sylvanna Forestmoon, just over there. She's been looking for another student.

11042|aa055e90.name: Sylvanna Forestmoon
11042|aa055e90.text: My skill at creating potions is inferior to yours. You are ready to speak with Ainethil, just over there. She will understand that you are ready for further instruction.

11068|bf2f71d7.name: Betty Quin
11068|bf2f71d7.text: Hail, traveler! What brings you to my doorstep?

1228|c2a278c1.name: Magis Sparkmantle
1228|c2a278c1.text: Greetings.  I'm a $c trainer, and you're a $c.

1229|617e9d53.name: Granis Swiftaxe
1229|617e9d53.text:
Yer no warrior... Why ye wouldn't even last a day under my training regimen!  

A $c who thinks he's a warrior.  Ha!

1241|4a926ca6.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|4a926ca6.text: Good day to ye lad. Can I be of service?

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1252|83b3b21e.name: Senir Whitebeard
1252|83b3b21e.text: Greetings and salutations to you, good $r. P'rhaps you'd like to share a drink with me, help fight off the chill of the wind? Come, I've more than enough to share.

12577|c5ceacbe.name: Jarrodenus
12577|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1257|fe52f4ea.name: Keldric Boucher
1257|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1265|a0959aba.name: Rudra Amberstill
1265|a0959aba.text: Welcome to the Amberstill Corral.  If you're interested in purchasing a mount, my husband Veron will be more than happy to help you choose just the right beast.  If you're looking for adventure, well we sure could use some help around here. . .

1275|ed056522.name: Kyra Boucher
1275|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1285|ed056522.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1286|ed056522.name: Edna Mullby
1286|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

12997|6ce695f2.name: Monty
12997|6ce695f2.text: Monty be me name an' rats be me game.

13018|0a2f0661.name: Nipsy
13018|0a2f0661.text: You'll find no finer rat kabob this side of Khaz Modan!

1317|29729a1b.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|29729a1b.text: If you have what it takes, I will be happy to show you the way.

1318|23d8b931.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1327|a381f669.name: Reese Langston
1327|a381f669.text: Welcome to the Pig and Whistle! Grab a drink my friend and pull up a seat, the more the merrier!

1340|76d04af9.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|76d04af9.text:
Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1355|0c543544.name: Cook Ghilm
1355|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1430|52392408.name: Tomas
1430|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

15077|873c8c0b.name: Riggle Bassbait
15077|873c8c0b.text:
Welcome to the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza where each week we choose the finest fisherman to be the Master Angler!

When the tournament is being held, schools of tastyfish will appear up and down the coast of Stranglethorn. While fishing, if your fishing bobber lands in a tastyfish school, then you will catch something from the school rather than the normal Stranglethorn fishing fare.

15078|07df529b.name: Jang
15078|07df529b.text:
Fishmaster Bassbait has had the waters here seeded with high quality tastyfish so he can have his weekly tournament.

Me? I'm here to hand out the prizes! Whether you win or simply have a few tastyfish to spare, I'm your gal.

15079|457990d2.name: Fishbot 5000
15079|457990d2.text:
*Whirr* *CLANK*

I have been instructed to accept high quality rare fish and return valuable Nat Pagle fishing accessories.   Fish Requested.

*THUMP* *Buzz*

15351|f54c92d6.name: Alliance Brigadier General
15351|f54c92d6.text: The war against the Horde has reached full tilt, $N.  This is a time of great need for the Alliance and it's quite necessary that all of us do our part to help.

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1681|d4740e3c.name: Brock Stoneseeker
1681|d4740e3c.text: The best miner has a firm grip on his pick, a stout heart in his chest, and thick, black dust in his hair.

1699|0c543544.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1699|b48f927f.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

1700|c2467ddc.name: Paxton Ganter
1700|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

1703|112fe3e7.name: Uthrar Threx
1703|112fe3e7.text: Welcome to me shop. What can I do for ye'?

1703|97c7cdfc.name: Uthrar Threx
1703|97c7cdfc.text: Hold on there, I'm just an assistant. If ye want to start learnin' the fancy stuff, talk to old Stonebrew over there.

1703|d69277e0.name: Uthrar Threx
1703|d69277e0.text: Excellent! I've been hopin' for a new student. Well, let's get started right away then!

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

214954|6cf4abd2.name: Rix Xizzix
214954|6cf4abd2.text:
Welcome to the Xizzix Asset Recovery Service! If you lost it, we probably found it! 

Check my stock to see if we've recovered anything that you might have carelessly discarded and have since decided you just can't live without.

227853|066d9580.name: Pix Xizzix
227853|066d9580.text: Impulse purchases are the most fun kind of purchases!

2326|a28d29e1.name: Thamner Pol
2326|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

240482|b1bbd58b.name: Berdun Cliffbrew
240482|b1bbd58b.text: Greetings, $c! What brings ye all the way out here?

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

241|2823b3ed.name: Remy "Two Times"
241|2823b3ed.text: Hey there, friend.  My name's Remy.  I'm from Redridge to the east, and came here looking for business, looking for business.  You got any...got any??

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do. Would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

247229|83e0509a.name: Daniel
247229|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

256729|06bc17cb.name: Nina Surefire
256729|06bc17cb.text:
I know what you're thinking, but don't worry, we keep our cooking and alchemy ingredients separate!

How can I help you?

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

258098|1605f087.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

261|a2b799cb.name: Guard Thomas
261|a2b799cb.text: Hello, citizen.  You look like a man with a purpose - do you have business with the Stormwind Army?

2627|dbf4383b.name: Grarnik Goodstitch
2627|dbf4383b.text: They say a stitch in time saves... what, eleven? Ah, I can't remember. Stupid saying anyway.

263644|f9f7abf6.name: Pherry Leftee
263644|f9f7abf6.text: Greetings, $N. Do you wish to enter a battle at Darkspear Islands?

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

2670|4b80d68c.name: Xizk Goodstitch
2670|4b80d68c.text: Welcome to my shop, $c. What is it the Goodstitch brothers can do for you?

271546|7dbe534f.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
271546|7dbe534f.text:
Lookin' fer the courier? Just flew off like a wee bird.

Can't say I blame the poor sod. These wendigos are nasty business.

2832|78a6229e.name: Nixxrax Fillamug
2832|78a6229e.text: First drink's on me! The coin to pay for it, that is. On my hand. From you.

2834|837eac47.name: Myizz Luckycatch
2834|837eac47.text: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.

2835|c5ceacbe.name: Cedrik Prose
2835|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2837|4a119c04.name: Jaxin Chong
2837|4a119c04.text: You're better at this gig than I am! You want someone with even more experience than I've got. That'd be Ainethil, a night elf lady who lives in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus.

2859|2cc67a59.name: Gyll
2859|2cc67a59.text: Fastest gryphons this side of Aerie Peak. Want to take a ride?

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3087|0c543544.name: Crystal Boughman
3087|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

328|9c6df40b.name: Zaldimar Wefhellt
328|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

331|9c6df40b.name: Maginor Dumas
331|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

342|bfa48dcd.name: Martie Jainrose
342|bfa48dcd.text: Hail, ROMAN!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

3964|a8767242.name: Kylanna
3964|a8767242.text: Although I am flattered by your confidence in my abilities, teaching you is beyond my skill. You must go to the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, and speak with the night elf Ainethil. She can help you.

415|fca64b70.name: Verner Osgood
415|fca64b70.text: Hey buddy, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

4160|fe17a639.name: Ainethil
4160|fe17a639.text: It is time you moved on to a more advanced teacher. In the Feathermoon Stronghold of Feralas dwells the night elf Kylanna Windwhisper. She has a brilliant mind; doubtless she can train you further.

4256|ec4d19c0.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
4256|ec4d19c0.text: If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a dwarf!

4900|e11677f7.name: Alchemist Narett
4900|e11677f7.text: There's nothing more I can teach you. I've heard of a night elf who might be able to, though. Her name is Ainethil, and she lives in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus.

4974|e9a7b43b.name: Aldwin Laughlin
4974|e9a7b43b.text: Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5153|4acd68fa.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|4acd68fa.text: Hmm... you show a little promise, I'll give you that. Okay then, where were we?

5159|3b48d638.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159|3b48d638.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

5159|9af6c3de.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159|9af6c3de.text: I keep 'em fed, kid. Yep, Daryl Riknussun, at yer service.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5494|ed056522.name: Catherine Leland
5494|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

5494|fe52f4ea.name: Catherine Leland
5494|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

5497|9c6df40b.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5566|bb901712.name: Tannysa
5566|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

5594|bbdc551e.name: Alchemist Pestlezugg
5594|bbdc551e.text: In need of some alchemy supplies, are we?  Or do you have other business with me?

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

6734|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Hearthstove
6734|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

6807|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Skindle
6807|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

68|f9dce0a3.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|f9dce0a3.text: Ahhh, Stormwind Visitor's Center is what you are looking for then. It's the first building on the left as you walk through the front gates from the Valley of Heroes.

714|7dd450ba.name: Talin Keeneye
714|7dd450ba.text: Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?

7406|12ee4ac6.name: Oglethorpe Obnoticus
7406|12ee4ac6.text:
Hello there lad... the name's Oglethorpe and I may be responsible for one of the amazing gnomish devices you might possess!  If it blew up, then it wasn't me; if it made you rich though, we can discuss royalties!

Oh, and if you're from Gnomeregan, you can just take two ninety degree angles, smash them together, and start marching.  I have nothing to say to you.

7823|c5ceacbe.name: Bera Stonehammer
7823|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

7853|967b8e4a.name: Scooty
7853|967b8e4a.text: Hello, $N! I am master engineer, Scooty.

786|b76e4f1a.name: Grelin Whitebeard
786|b76e4f1a.text: Greetings, lad. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

8508|15b608c8.name: Gretta Ganter
8508|15b608c8.text: Lookin' to fish? Then you'll need the proper tools.

907|dad0bc87.name: Keras Wolfheart
907|dad0bc87.text: I hope that you're here to help us take back Arathi Basin from The Defilers.  What do you say $N?

9099|672307d5.name: Sraaz
9099|672307d5.text: This cherry pie tastes so good, it could make a grown $r cry.

925|837f02f9.name: Brother Sammuel
925|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

944|c2a278c1.name: Marryk Nurribit
944|c2a278c1.text: Greetings.  I'm a $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

9559|c670fd35.name: Grizzlowe
9559|c670fd35.text: I must say, Booty Bay has the best Clam Chowder to be had anywhere in the South Seas. Oh, not interested in cuisine eh? Well then let me be the first to welcome you to the berth of the Maiden's Fancy, the finest passenger ship to travel between the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. She's due back for another trip to Ratchet in the Barrens soon, so make yourself comfortable till she arrives.

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2160-progress.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-progress.text: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
2160-progress.title: Supplies to Tannok

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

282-progress.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-progress.text:
Hail! Have a care, $N, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
282-progress.title: Senir's Observations

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

308-progress.name: Jarven Thunderbrew
308-progress.text: Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!
308-progress.title: Distracting Jarven

310-progress.name: Unknown
310-progress.text: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
310-progress.title: Bitter Rivals

3101-progress.name: Brother Sammuel
3101-progress.text: Finally! We meet face to face, brother to sister. I welcome you to Northshire. This will be your home for a short time while you learn the ins and outs of how things are done, but know that Stormwind is not far off, and sooner or later, your path will take you there. But until then, be patient... Knight of the Silver Hand.
3101-progress.title: Consecrated Letter

3114-progress.name: Marryk Nurribit
3114-progress.text: Yeah, what's that, $r? Speak up, if you don't mind. I don't hear so good after a few ales.
3114-progress.title: Glyphic Memorandum

312-progress.name: Tundra MacGrann
312-progress.text: Were you able to get into my meat locker, $N?
312-progress.title: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash

313-progress.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-progress.text: Hey, $N.  Been to the Grizzled Den yet?  Those Wendigos can be fierce.
313-progress.title: The Grizzled Den

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

315-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-progress.text: Do you have that shimmerweed?  I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
315-progress.title: The Perfect Stout

317-progress.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-progress.text: Preparations are going well.  How goes your hunting?
317-progress.title: Stocking Jetsteam

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

384-progress.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-progress.text: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, $N.
384-progress.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

400-progress.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-progress.text:
Hm?  You look a little young to be a siege engine pilot.  But no matter...do you need something fixed?

Well take a number and get comfortable.  I'm working on a couple engines right now and won't have time for another job for at least a few days.

Or, were you here for something else...?
400-progress.title: Tools for Steelgrill

413-progress.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-progress.text:
Hello, $C!  And what business takes you all the way out here?

Something exciting, I hope.  I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...
413-progress.title: Shimmer Stout

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

420-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-progress.text: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.
420-progress.title: Senir's Observations

5541-progress.name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
5541-progress.text: I hope you're not here for ammo, because I'm almost out!
5541-progress.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

6387-progress.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6387-progress.text: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
6387-progress.title: Honor Students

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

6392-progress.name: Brock Stoneseeker
6392-progress.text: Ah, $N.  Have you returned from Ironforge?
6392-progress.title: Return to Brock

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6662-progress.name: Nipsy
6662-progress.text:
<Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>

Alive and kicking... and just in time!
6662-progress.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

8193-complete.name: Riggle Bassbait
8193-complete.text:
Hurry up and hand those over if you want to be declared a Master Angler! I have been standing around here for HOURS with nothing to eat!

What are you waiting for? Do you WANT to be a loser?
8193-complete.title: Master Angler

8193-progress.name: Riggle Bassbait
8193-progress.text:
Every Sunday, we have a contest to determine the greatest anglers of them all! Just be among the FIRST 50 PEOPLE to bring me some Tastyfish fished from the Tastyfish schools found along the coasts of Stranglethorn and you will be declared a Master Angler!

If you're too slow, my apprentice here will still reward you with money for some Tastyfish you bring her.

Oh, and don't delay, Tastyfish go bad quickly, so don't even think about holding onto them for next week!
8193-progress.title: Master Angler

8221-progress.name: Fishbot 5000
8221-progress.text:
*Whir* *Click*

  I seek rare fish for Fishmaster Bluegill to catalogue.   If you bring me a Keefer's Angelfish, I will provide you with this fine reward. 

 *Zzzap* *Whir*
8221-progress.title: Rare Fish - Keefer's Angelfish

8224-progress.name: Fishbot 5000
8224-progress.text:
*Whir* *Click*

  I seek rare fish for Fishmaster Bluegill to catalogue.   If you bring me a Dezian Queenfish, I will provide you with this fine reward. 

 *Zzzap* *Whir*
8224-progress.title: Rare Fish - Dezian Queenfish

8225-progress.text:
*Whir* *Click*

  I seek rare fish for Fishmaster Bluegill to catalogue.   If you bring me a Brownell's Blue Striped Racer, I will provide you with this fine reward. 

 *Zzzap* *Whir*
8225-progress.title: Rare Fish - Brownell's Blue Striped Racer

83-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
83-progress.text: I'm running low on linen, $N.  Do you have any for me?
83-progress.title: Red Linen Goods

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

95214-progress.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95214-progress.text: I hope you've got good news for me?
95214-progress.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

96628-progress.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628-progress.title: The Adventurer

97277-progress.name: Grund Drokda
97277-progress.text: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277-progress.title: Grund and Gozwin

98321-progress.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-progress.text: Wendigos are nasty beasties. It's just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
98321-progress.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98323-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-progress.text:
Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323-progress.title: Secure the Mountain

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force

98896-complete.name: Alliance Brigadier General
98896-complete.text:
Excellent work, $c! With each blow struck against the Darkspear Raiders, we move one step closer to total victory. 

For the Alliance!
98896-complete.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98896-progress.name: Alliance Brigadier General
98896-progress.text: The fight in the Darkspear Islands continues, $N. Rally your forces and crush the Darkspear Raiders!
98896-progress.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

99158-progress.name: Father Gavin
99158-progress.text: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158-progress.title: Dawn in the Mountains
